preRegistration.text:
# Pre-registration: WASP-52 b, MicroObservatory night of 2026-09-20 UT

SCAFFOLD from tools/mobs_night.py. Edit the judgment lines, then commit BEFORE any fit.

Frames: 78, 03:46 to 07:37 UT, 60.0 s Clear.
Archive (NEA pscomppars, fetched 2026-09-20 18:14 UTC): P 1.74977980 +/- 1.2e-06 d,
T0 2455793.681430 +/- 9.0e-05, T14 1.810 h, Rp/Rs 0.1646 (depth 2.71%), a/Rs 7.3801,
inc 85.35, e 0.0, Teff 5000.0, V 12.192. Epoch 3149: predicted Tmid 2461303.73802 (05:42 UT),
ingress 04:48, egress 06:37; 62 min pre-ingress and 60 min post-egress in the window
(full). Propagated ephemeris bar 5.6 min.

Predictions:
- Sky judged by stars per frame and the target's aperture flux (night_triage), not the background.
  If the counts hold through 04:48-06:37 and the seed target is >200 ADU above background:
  QC PASS predicted. Every one of the 78 frames is clear, all 36 in-transit frames included, with an hour of baseline
  on each side; the target reads 305 ADU on the seed (above the floor, though nearer to it than WASP-67 b's 453);
  six comparisons at 2.2-7.6x the target. One pointing step (dy range -111 px), which the aperture tracking has
  handled on every night so far. If MARGINAL, the likeliest cause is scatter rather than coverage: this same star
  on 09-13 delivered 1.81% (PASS) against a calibration that now predicts ~0.87%, so the law's flat floor may not
  hold for this field. Prediction on scatter: between 0.9 and 1.8%; a value near 1.8 again says the field, not the
  sky, sets this target's noise.
- Scatter, from the V-magnitude calibration (0.84% at V 11.57 on 2026-09-05, +0.05%/mag from three clean nights, revised 2026-09-18):
  ~0.87%. On a 2.71% depth that is scatter/depth 0.32; with 0.425 giving
  8.2 min at ~3 min cadence, expected Tmid bar ~6 min (range 4-9; two clean nights gave 9.6 and 8.6 against 6.7 and 9.0 predicted, so the bar model is two-point-crude).
  Under 4 min: calibration wrong the other way. Over 11 min: worse night than the counts show.
- Tmid within 1 sigma (that bar) of 2461303.73802. Two prior nights of this target are the context: 08-24 came out +13 min
  on a clouded baseline (the cloud-baseline bias, first seen there), and 09-13 passed. A miss here in the LATE direction
  on a night with no lost frames would mean the +13 min was not cloud alone, and the first thing to examine would be
  the comparison choice, not the archive. A miss in either direction inside the 5.6 min ephemeris bar means nothing.
  ExoClock's ephemeris for this well-observed planet is the second check and will be applied the next morning; the
  archive prior for WASP-67 b was 5.6 min stale and this one may be too.
- Depth within 1 sigma of 2.71%; Rp/Rs within 1 sigma of 0.1646.
- If stars-per-frame falls by more than half at any point between 04:48 and 06:37, or the target is under
  ~200 ADU above background in the seed frame: expect FAIL or a rejected night, and the record will say so
  with no depth or timing claim.
- Any printed bar under 0.001 d is a replaced bar (#1401) and gets refit before the ledger.
- First-frame coordinates from a local plate solve; drift by star-pair voting; comps in the triage box within a
  brightness factor of the target; #1409 confirms the rest.
- Not submitted regardless; checkpoint holds.

parameters.Fit parameter point estimate: Best-fit likelihood point; uncertainties are posterior spread.
parameters.Prefit refinement note: Using an initial nested fit to estimate a transit duration of 0.074846 day(s), kept the full light curve because no extra baseline points fell outside the target window, and setting the second-pass Tmid bounds to [2461303.709047, 2461303.783894].
parameters.Pre-UltraNest LM boundary scout note: LM solution and covariance envelope were interior after 4 iteration(s).
parameters.Out-of-transit baseline parameter-fit no: Not used in the final refit because the out-of-transit linear detrending already flattened the final-fit flux baseline.
parameters.Out-of-transit baseline detrending note: Applied weighted linear out-of-transit baseline detrending using 23 pre-ingress and 14 post-egress points.
parameters.Sparse posterior live-point extension no: Applied additive selected comparison-star final UltraNest extension (200->1200 minimum live points).
parameters.Final residual rejection note: No residual outliers exceeded 3.0 sigma from the iterated median residual (-0.1150%, stdev=1.0586%).
parameters.Uncertainty interpretation note: The primary Rp/R* and radius-ratio area-depth uncertainties use model+red-noise when available. The red-noise uncertainty inflates the data-fit standard error by a residual time-binning beta factor before combining it with the model posterior. The flux baseline red-noise uncertainty is the out-of-transit baseline component used for the final-plot baseline band; the transit-depth red-noise uncertainty already includes both the in-transit and baseline terms. The same residual time-binning beta factor is applied to the posterior uncertainties for Tmid, a/Rs, inclination, and impact parameter when reporting their primary model+red-noise uncertainties. The flux-scatter equivalent is also shown as a diagnostic of the full residual scatter around the model.
